build.type: self-contained verification APK; release-mode, non-minified, debug-key-signed; not a production release artifact

deviceInteraction.launch: passed via Android activity manager; no Metro dependency or red screen
deviceInteraction.welcome: rendered the Welcome heading, benefit list and Continue button
deviceInteraction.continue: opened Sign in screen with email and password fields
deviceInteraction.emptySignIn: displayed Invalid email address validation message

limitations: One isolated demo baseline on one Android emulator. No minified production APK, model-generated candidate, held-out task success, repair outcome, real authentication, customer app, or same-model improvement comparison was verified. The device tool's app-open helper could not attach because this release-mode APK is non-debuggable; launch used Android's activity manager and screen observations used the device tool.
